_comment: Illegal variants cloned from the COMMITTED real-client project (base: "client").
These prove the format gate is not tuned to build.js output only: a project the
official EasyEDA Pro client authored must still fail loudly when corrupted.
The clone lives in a temp directory; the repository is never modified.

illegal.name: client-panel-file-deleted
illegal.title: panel/Panel1.epan2 deleted while profile.panels still lists it

illegal.name: client-sheet-uuid-mismatch
illegal.title: the sheet's SCH_PAGE doc uuid no longer matches the uuid the index lists
illegal.mutate: rewrite the main DOCHEAD uuid of P1.esch2

validate: last doc must be SCH_PAGE with uuid

illegal.name: client-schematic-uuid-mismatch
illegal.title: Schematic1.ecfg carries a doc uuid the index does not know
illegal.mutate: rewrite the SCH DOCHEAD uuid inside the .ecfg

validate: want a single SCH doc with uuid

illegal.name: auto-named-net
illegal.title: the NET label removed from a wired node: an unnamed N$ net reaches the layout
illegal.mutate: delete the ATTR whose key is NET and value LED_A
